title: Applications in agriculture and medicine
notes: - **Bt Cotton**: Contains Bacillus thuringiensis gene for insect resistance
- **Bt Corn**: Pest-resistant corn expressing Bt toxin
- **Drought-resistant crops**: Modified for water stress tolerance
- **Insulin**: Produced by E. coli using rDNA technology (replaced animal insulin)
- **Gene Therapy**: Treating genetic disorders by replacing faulty genes
- **Pharming**: Animals producing pharmaceutical proteins in milk
- **Biopiracy**: Unauthorized commercial use of biological resources
- **Basmati rice case**: US patent on Indian basmati (later revoked)
- **Neem case**: EU patent on neem derivatives (revoked)
- **Wheat case**: US patent on Indian wheat (revoked)
- **Protected Biological Resources**: Nepal has traditional knowledge databases
- Using microbes to clean up environmental pollutants
- Oil-spill cleanup: Pseudomonas putida degrades hydrocarbons
- Heavy metal removal: Bioaccumulation by certain microbes
Applications of Bt crops; Insulin production; Biopiracy examples.
